description: Java class UnsafeSorterSpillReader for reading spill files written by UnsafeSorterSpillWriter in Apache Spark, handling buffered input streams, record parsing, and resource management.

classes.name: UnsafeSorterSpillReader
classes.description: A final class that reads spill files produced by UnsafeSorterSpillWriter, managing input streams, record data, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: UnsafeSorterSpillReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing input streams, reading record count, and setting up task completion cleanup.

methods.name: getNumRecords
methods.description: Returns total number of records in the spill file.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if more records are available to read.

methods.name: loadNext
methods.description: Reads the next record from the input stream, handling buffer resizing and task interruption.

methods.name: getBaseObject
methods.description: Returns the base object containing the current record data.

methods.name: getBaseOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the base object, using Platform.BYTE_ARRAY_OFFSET.

methods.name: getRecordLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the current record.

methods.name: getKeyPrefix
methods.description: Returns the key prefix of the current record.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes input streams and releases resources.
